evidence: Spelling: tokenised all 599 distinct words of instruction.md plus the three /instructions notes and reviewed the full list by hand; no misspellings (British-neutral usage, contractions such as mustn't/won't correct). All four files are pure ASCII, LF-only (0 CR bytes). Contamination: grep for TODO|FIXME|XXX|CHANGE_ME|<placeholder>|TBD|lorem and for foreign paths (C:\, /Users/, /home/, F:/, Documents, turing) and grader words (solution, golden, judge, rubric, claude) found nothing except the ordinary word 'documents' (instruction.md:1, conversations.md:13). Template CHANGE_ME stubs (template instruction.md:1, notes.md:1) are fully replaced; template notes.md is not shipped. No duplicated paragraphs or author asides. Internal consistency: one clock (integration.md:7 2026-05-12T11:00:00Z = seed clock), one seed path (/assets/seed_data.json in instruction.md:5 and integration.md:5, COPYed by environment/Dockerfile), one account list (walls-and-retention.md:5-11 matches the 5 seed accounts, emails, names and roles; only partner is Harriet), wall 'Dev Anand is walled from M-12' matches seed M-12 walled=[dev@kittle.test], timer options off/1/7/30 match seed timer_options_days [null,1,7,30], DB path /app/app.db with DB_PATH override (instruction.md:5 refined by integration.md:3) and the launch env list (PATH, NODE_PATH, HOME, PORT=3000, DB_PATH) matches tests/test.sh:104-109. Delete/hold rules agree across files (conversations.md:9 'unless a partner has put them on hold' vs walls-and-retention.md:29 'Nobody, including its author, can delete a held message'); deleted-with-replies placeholder is consistent between conversations.md:9, walls-and-retention.md:25 and :35. The misspelling 'recieved' exists only inside seed K-2 earlier-version text ('Landlords notice recieved.'), which is deliberate edit-history data matching 'People fix typos' and is not part of the instruction. Adversarial angle: no line a model could read two contradictory ways from a pasting/editing accident; ambiguity of requirements is out of scope for this row (row 6). Deterministic check-instruction-content/hygiene executables were not run by me; this is a manual application of the same markers only.
